center-page-content-set-display-duration.title: Center Page Content and Set Display Duration on a Specific PDF Page
center-page-content-set-display-duration.description: Demonstrates how to center the content of a specific PDF page and set its display duration using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor facade.

add-5-percent-margins-and-print-pdf.title: Add 5% Margins and Print PDF
add-5-percent-margins-and-print-pdf.description: Shows how to add a 5 % margin to every page of a PDF using PdfFileEditor and then print the modified document with PdfViewer.

add-15-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.title: Add 15% Margins to PDF Pages for Booklet Layout
add-15-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to apply a 15 % margin to selected or all pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, improving readability and binding margins for booklet layouts.

rotate-pdf-pages-to-landscape-brochure.title: Rotate PDF Pages to Landscape for Brochure Printing
rotate-pdf-pages-to-landscape-brochure.description: Shows how to rotate every page of a PDF to landscape orientation and set the page size to A4 using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor, preparing the document for brochure printing.

change-pdf-page-size-to-a3.title: Change PDF Page Size to A3 Using PdfPageEditor
change-pdf-page-size-to-a3.description: Shows how to resize all pages of a PDF to A3 dimensions and optionally increase resolution using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor class.

set-pdf-page-zoom-preview-final.title: Set PDF Page Zoom for Preview and Final Output
set-pdf-page-zoom-preview-final.description: Shows how to generate a preview PDF at 50 % zoom and a final PDF at 100 % zoom using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

hybrid-content-resize-mixed-margins.title: Hybrid Content Resize with Mixed Percentage and Absolute Margins
hybrid-content-resize-mixed-margins.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor to resize PDF page contents by specifying a mix of percentage‑based and absolute margins.

apply-page-transitions-by-index.title: Apply Different Page Transitions Based on Index
apply-page-transitions-by-index.description: Demonstrates how to assign a different transition effect to each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor, cycling through three transition types based on the page number.

apply-rotation-size-zoom-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply Rotation, Size, and Zoom to PDF Pages
apply-rotation-size-zoom-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor facade to rotate pages, change the page size, apply a zoom factor, and save the edited PDF.
